bayts.text: You are my Lord, and You have been for me according to my love; to You is my gratitude, for the Garden, with ink.
To You is my gratitude for every lawful (good) You have driven to me, for the Garden, endowed with rectitude.
To You (belongs) my whole being, O Possessor of Permanence, (a being) endowed with permanence, (as) a sign from You, forever, O my support.
Grant me, forever, to endure as a joy for the Beloved (Muḥammad), through whom upon You (rests) my reliance.
From You I seek for him the peace of the Loving (Al-Wadūd), endowed with permanence, that it be for me according to my wish.
Encompass me (with Your protection), forever, (making me) endowed with contentment and safety; shield my household from plague and from locusts.
Extend to me from You what I wish, in perpetuity, and through my writing raise up sublimity, in a singular way.
From You I seek, without end, the peace of the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ) for the assembly of the noble servants.
O Everlasting (Ad-Dāʾim), write for me contentment with my household, and give glad tidings to the Best of creatures (Muḥammad) through my ink.
Truly the Possessor of generosity, sublimity and beauty, the King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), Possessor of guidance and perfection,
is worthy of gratitude, and He is Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr); and through him (the Prophet) I have sought to thank Him with what is lawful.
To me He drives the lawful without reckoning, and through my writing He dispels every straying.
He has demolished harm away from my person, perpetually, and with a good endowed with beauty He is lavish toward me.
He has extended to me His favour without end, through the generous Prophet, without any disturbance.
My praise, forever, (goes) to Him Who has driven a favour, through the trustworthy Messenger, to me without interruption.
My King has extended to me the munificence of an Everlasting One, endowed with nearness to Him, without separation.
(My blessing) upon the Prophet has made me possess my wish; I have said this in gratitude, without vainglory.
O Everlasting, write for him the peace of the Loving (Al-Wadūd), on my behalf and on behalf of my household.
My King has taken harm away from me and from my household: the distress that was in me has vanished.
To Him Whose kingdom endures (goes) my joy; He has kept my whole being from harm in my exile.
To the generous God (go) my praise and my gratitude, (I) who pray upon the Prophet, for my drawing near.
Allah has demolished the edifice of harm (away) from me, and through the Best of creatures He has dispelled the distress that was in me.
(He) has bestowed knowledge and aspirations, with permanence, through him who does not belong to despoiling.
I have obtained from my King, through the Best of creatures, the best of help against the enemies, by (their) overturning.
The praise of my Lord and the praise of the best of those who pray (Muḥammad) have led to me the whole of aspirations, like milk that flows forth.
Extend the best of blessings, without end, with peace, O Intimate One Who has been alone with me,
perpetually, upon him (the Prophet) through whom I have written for myself the best permanence, which does not belong to despoiling.
